XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Abnormal battery absorption and generic failure light on, odometer flashing
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | U1733 | B10AA | CONTROL UNIT | BLUETOOTH | FLASHING | INTERMITTENT | WORKING | WELL | MILEAGE | KM | TOTAL | VEHICLE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with a Bluetooth system

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Bluetooth control unit

  • Fault: Odometer flashing, whilst the vehicle is operating correctly

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • U1733 (Convergence L1 and L2 telematics node)
    • B10AA (Proxy alignment check)
  • Cause: Faulty Bluetooth control unit

• Action: Check the operation and condition of the Bluetooth control unit; if necessary, repair or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the faulty control unit showed no visible faults. After replacement, the problem was permanently resolved. The component is located in the passenger compartment, behind the glove box, in a central position; it can be accessed by moving a trim panel and removing a plastic cover.
